summary: Iteration 3 security hardening fully validated. Backend: 58/58 pytest tests green (24 M1 + 15 M2 shift sync + 19 NEW security tests in /app/backend/tests/test_security_hardening.py). New tests cover: (1) per-account throttle fires 429 on the 11th wrong login across 10 different X-Forwarded-For values and the per-IP throttle fires 429 on the 6th same-IP wrong attempt; unknown emails get the same 401 'Incorrect email or password' and are throttled identically; a successful /auth/reset-password clears the account throttle so login works immediately with the new password. (2) Anti-enumeration: /auth/register, /auth/forgot-password and /auth/resend-verification return identical 202 bodies for existing-verified, existing-unverified and unknown emails; unknown-email and wrong-password logins return identical 401; response times for forgot-password known vs unknown are within 2.5s (background email send); 403 'email_not_verified' only occurs with the CORRECT password on an unverified account (confirmed by distinct 401 for wrong password). (3) CORS: OPTIONS preflight from https://evil.example receives NO access-control-allow-origin header, while https://dutyconnect-beta.preview.emergentagent.com is echoed; POST without an Origin header (native-app simulation) succeeds (200). (4) Prisoner-data guard: /api/shifts/sync returns 422 for location values 'A1234BC', 'prisoner smith', 'inmate bay 3', 'NOMIS office', 'cell 12', 'wing B2'; accepts 'Local hospital' (applied). Frontend smoke (390x844 web): registered delivered+sec555124@resend.dev → verify screen → seeded code 246810 in db.action_codes → verify succeeded → home-screen reached; logged out via account-signout-row; logged back in as delivered+t1@resend.dev / Testpass123; forgot-password from login → reset-screen → seeded reset code → updated password to Testpass123 (same) → redirected to /login with 'Password updated — please sign in' toast. Cleanup: db.login_attempts cleared, 4 ephemeral test users and 3 action_codes removed, main user intact with email_verified=true and Testpass123 preserved (final curl /auth/login returned 200). Deprecated-package audit: expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch not present. Shadow* and pointerEvents warnings remain (carryover). No new React Native issues introduced by this iteration.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py login(): correct dual-key throttle. acct_key uses hmac(JWT_SECRET, email) so it works for unknown emails too, preventing enumeration by throttle presence. ip_key is salted with the email so a shared IP across different accounts isn't locked out together. 15-minute expiry via TTL index on login_attempts.expires_at avoids permanent lockout. Password-reset path explicitly clears the account key (server.py:386), so an attacker cannot DoS a real officer out indefinitely.
server.py: _DUMMY_HASH + verify_password runs even when the user is missing, so unknown-email timing roughly matches wrong-password timing (both do one bcrypt). Good.

server.py send_later / deliver: email sending is fire-and-forget on a stored task set, so register/forgot/resend return 202 without waiting on the SMTP proxy. This eliminates the previous timing side channel for known vs unknown emails (confirmed by test_forgot_password_response_time_similar).

server.py CORS: allow_origins read from CORS_ORIGINS env (comma-separated), allow_credentials=False, approved preflight returns the exact origin, evil origin gets no ACAO. Native apps (no Origin header) are unaffected because CORS only applies to browser-origin requests.

server.py shift validators: PRISONER_NO_RE catches 'A1234BC'; SENSITIVE_WORDS_RE case-insensitive and uses \b boundaries, so 'cell 12' and 'wing B2' are caught, 'Local hospital' passes. Applies to both location and officer_name.

Potential long-term concern (not an issue for this milestone): per-account throttle counter is upserted on EVERY wrong login, including before the user record exists. An attacker could probe the throttle counter via timing on {acct_key:found}; but since both acct_key and ip_key are hashed and the response is identical, this is acceptable.
